preflight_verdict_meaning: Current 01C-SQLITE-2 cannot claim MD-015 scoped validity. A bounded SQLite successor is feasible if and only if the write API stops persisting caller-supplied full next_state and instead applies a scoped command onto latest loaded authority (same MD-015 standard as Append 01B-3). Naive remove-generation-check-only is insufficient and creates a full-state overwrite trap.

verdicts_rejected.REQUIRE_NEW_AUTHORITY_SEMANTICS: not primary — physical SQLite transactional container can host the same scoped-apply-onto-latest class as 01B-3
